body:
## Pull request overview

This PR wires up an in-memory analytics implementation in the Console’s demo/MSW kernel so `/api/v1/analytics/*` endpoints work in mock environments (instead of returning 405 due to a missing `analytics` service).

**Changes:**
- Register `MemoryAnalyticsService` in `createKernel()` (with a small adapter for `getMetadata()` ↔ `getMeta()` naming).
- Auto-generate basic cube definitions from `appConfig.objects` via `buildCubesFromConfig()`.
- Extend the broker shim to route `analytics.query`, `analytics.meta`, and `analytics.sql` calls.

The MSW integration test suite covers /api/v1/data/* but there’s no test exercising the newly enabled /api/v1/analytics/* paths. Please add an MSWServer integration test that hits at least /api/v1/analytics/meta and /api/v1/analytics/query (verifying they don’t 405 and return a shaped success payload) so this wiring doesn’t regress silently.

In the broker shim, analytics requests call kernel.getService('analytics') on every broker.call(). Unlike protocol (captured once), this adds unnecessary async overhead per request. Consider resolving the analytics service once when installing the shim (and reinstalling after bootstrap as you already do) and then dispatching directly to the cached reference.
